itens.trecho: Memorável e intemporal. Este filme é um dos clássicos de acção que nunca mais saiu das televisões desde que estreou. E é também um filme que vi ainda criança, e que paro para ver quase sempre que passa nas televisões, o que acontece regularmente.

So, it is time to review the last good Terminator movie. When T3 came out, I swear that people forgot it was even released... but at least it felt like it belonged in the Terminator franchise. When Salvation dropped, it felt like it fit as well, but it was an MCG film, so it also felt like Terminator meets Mickey Mouse.

I'm never really a fan of kids in movies, but Edward Furlong turns in some attitude here with his performance as the ten year old "John Connor". Turns out that he is the target of the the latest "Skynet" plot to destroy the resistance to their impending world domination (in a worryingly close 2029!).
